## Mathematical claim

State the strongest exact claim.  Distinguish lower bounds, conditional upper
bounds, heuristics, finite-characteristic evidence, and failed routes.

## Certificate

- [ ] explicit curve/family equations
- [ ] complete points/sections
- [ ] exact substitution
- [ ] independence proof
- [ ] height matrix and determinant where applicable
- [ ] saturation scope
- [ ] software versions and proof flags
- [ ] hashes and provenance
- [ ] independent second implementation

## Adversarial audit

List attempted counterexamples, numerical-instability checks, duplicate or
torsion handling, and any unresolved assumptions.

## Truth status

Choose one: false / incomplete / heuristic only / restricted obstruction / new
representation / new intermediate theorem / candidate construction / certified
rank at least 30.
